description.en: Conveyor belt sushi provides the section names for Electric 20 Concrete Pump. Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai publishes Electric 20 Concrete Pump. The published table prints Motor Power 22 kW; Output Capacity 8–10 m³/h; Max. Outlet Pressure 10 MPa; Hopper Capacity 0.25 m³; Pumping Distance (H / V) 120 m / 40 m; Delivery Pipe Diameter 80 mm; Max. Aggregate Size 1–2 cm; Dimensions (L×W×H) 2800 × 1300 × 1500 mm; Main Unit Weight 900 kg. Not printed, so left blank: cylinder bore, piston stroke, service life, a material grade number. The content photograph does not add a figure that the table omits.
